# Class

Show classes, their members, and the relationships between them.

===! "Diagram"

    ```mermaid

      class:
        hierarchicalNamespaces: false

    classDiagram
        namespace Earth.Volcano.Summit {
            class Crater {
                +erupt()
            }
        }
        namespace Earth.Volcano.Slope {
            class LavaFlow {
                +buildLand()
            }
        }
        namespace Earth {
            class Hotspot {
                +meltRock()
            }
        }
        Hotspot --> Crater : feeds
        Hotspot --> LavaFlow : feeds
    ```

===! "Diagram"

    ```mermaid
    ---
    title: Reef animal example
    ---
    classDiagram
        note "From Turtle till Whale"
        Animal <|-- Turtle
        note for Turtle "can swim<br>can dive<br>can nest on beaches<br>can live for decades"
        Animal <|-- Shark
        Animal <|-- Whale
        Animal : +int age
        Animal : +String name
        Animal: +isMammal()
        Animal: +migrate()
        class Turtle{
            +String shellColor
            +swim()
            +nest()
        }
        class Shark{
            -int sizeInFeet
            -canHunt()
        }
        class Whale{
            +bool is_humpback
            +sing()
        }
    ```
